name: Set Survey Public Link
script:
# Fetch the base URL dynamically
base_url = frappe.utils.get_url()

# Define the survey URL path
survey_path = "/survey-response/"

# Check if the public link is already set
if not doc.public_link:
    # Generate the link dynamically
    doc.public_link = f"{base_url}{survey_path}{doc.name}"
    doc.save()
